karakterler.rol: AdventurerStudent President of Rude Mercenary Company
karakterler.baslangic: Rudeus stands at around average height (175cm), has a muscular body despite being a magician, and his looks weren't that poor when his family members are asked.
karakterler.ozet: Rudeus was a 34-year-old NEET otaku in his previous life. As the fourth child of five children in a well-off family, he was praised as a bright student in elementary school considering his age. In junior high, he joined the computer club and and saved up his allowance to assemble his very own computer. However, he was so focused on tinkering his computer that he neglected his studies, causing him to fail the entrance exam of his preferred high school. As a result, the only school that would take him was a low-quality one, filled to the brim with delinquents.

karakterler.baslangic: Roxy is shown as a short statured adult woman in her physical teenage appearance between 15 or 16 years old.
karakterler.ozet: Roxy is born to Rowin Migurdia and Rokari Migurdia of the Migurd Tribe, part of the Race in the Demon Continent. However, she was born without her race's special ability to communicate telepathically, so her parents taught her how to talk normally. Throughout her childhood, she would often always feel annoyed and isolated with her race's silent conversation and ran away from her village after being impressed by a Magician who visited her village one day. Roxy becomes an Adventurer to get some money in order to leave the Demon Continent where she joins the party Rikarisu Gang with Dale, Nokopara and Blaze but the party eventually disbanded after the death of Dale.

karakterler.baslangic: Sylphy has pale skin, elfish ears, and red eyes.
She is pointed to be beautiful with long red hair, red eyes and nice figure.
karakterler.ozet: Her full name is Eris Boreas Greyrat. The Boreas was one of the great noble families in the Asura Kingdom who rules the Fittoa Region. Her behavior prior to meeting Rudeus was uncontrollable and violent. She was considered a failure as a noble. After the Teleport Incident, she was accompanied by Rudeus and Ruijerd on her way to the Central Continent.

karakterler.baslangic: Paul was a tall, muscular and handsome man with sandy light-brown hair where part of his hair is short that frames his face while the rest is gathered in a long ponytail that rests above his shoulder, green eyes and a mole near his left eye.
karakterler.ozet:
thumb|left|300px|Paul and Zenith settling down in Buena Village
Paul's birth name is Paul Notos Greyrat, born from a high ranking noble family in the Asura Kingdom. He got into a fight with his father Amarant and decided to leave his house and throw away the Notos name to become an adventurer. From there he formed a party called Fangs of the Black Wolf consisting of six members, him included. Sometime later, he got married to one of his team members, Zenith, who gave birth to Rudeus Greyrat and they settle in Buena Village.

karakterler.baslangic: Zenith is a beautiful, young woman who has blonde hair that she normally ties in a ponytail with chin-length hair strands hanging on either side, blue shaded eyes, she has a slender build and a voluptuous figure with large breasts (which Norn Greyrat inherited) and she appears more youthful than her actual age as noted in, as a result of her being trapped in a magic crystal after the Teleport Incident.
karakterler.ozet:
===Volume 1===
right|thumb|Zenith after giving birth to Rudeus
Zenith is first introduced after giving birth to Rudeus Greyrat and she uses healing magic on him when he falls hitting his head. Zenith later asks Paul Greyrat to hire a magic tutor when Rudeus uses Water Cannon, an intermediate ranked water magic, believing that Rudeus will grow up to be a mage. ===Volume 6===
right|thumb|Kishirika telling Roxy that Zenith is in the Teleportation Labyrinth
After paying for Kishirika Kishirisu's debt from drinking, Roxy requests her to look for Rudeus' family with her Clairvoyant Eyes and tells Roxy that Zenith is located in Rapan, Begaritt Continent but upon further checking, Kishirika could…

karakterler.baslangic: Lilia is a very beautiful Human woman who as has reddish-brown hair that is tied up in a half bun while she has chest-length hair strands resting on either side of her shoulders, violet-purple eyes and she has a very slender and voluptuous body with very large breasts.
karakterler.ozet:
=== Infancy Period ===
After Lilia accepted the job as the maid of the Greyrat family where she assists in giving birth to Rudeus Greyrat. But upon seeing Rudeus' face showing a perverted face, she take on an immediate dislike for Rudeus, thinking that he was a creepy child who made weird expressions especially when he was pressed against a woman's chest like he is possessed by an evil spirit. Despite getting along with Zenith, Lilia avoided Rudeus whenever she could, often turning the other way. Once, she had even found his box which had Roxy Migurdia's panties in it but she did not say anything about it.

karakterler.baslangic: Norn has blond hair and green eyes.
karakterler.ozet: Norn is the second child of Paul and Zenith who was born a few hours prior to Aisha Greyrat on the same day where she used to live in the Village of Buena in the Boreas Region before the Teleport Incident and later moved to the Millishion, Millis Continent for a few years with Paul and briefly with the Latreia family. For most part of the story, she lives with her brother in Sharia with her family and attends the Magic University of Ranoa. Like Rudeus, She has Greyrat Nobility and Latreia Nobility blood in her. 'Note: This section is under construction and revision.

karakterler.rol: MaidAdviserVice President of Rude Mercenary Company
karakterler.baslangic: Aisha has maroon hair that parts from the middle of her head, frames her face and tied behind her head.
karakterler.ozet:
250px|left|thumb|Aisha being cared for by Lilia in the Anime
Before Aisha was born, her mother Lilia was urgently hired by Paul who is expecting their first child and immediately got hired to be their maid since they are acquainted in their childhood and she also has experiences handling child deliveries. Due to hearing Paul and Zenith's moans every night, Lilia eventually gave in to her desire and seduces Paul and by the time Zenith got pregnant with Norn, Lilia revealed to be pregnant as well with Paul being the father.

karakterler.baslangic: Ruijerd is tall for an average Superd, muscular build, handsome and shared their distinctive features such as porcelain white skin and emerald green hair with a red gemstone on his forehead.
karakterler.ozet:
200px|right|thumb|Rudeus and Eris meeting Ruijerd
Ruijerd meets Rudeus and Eris who are transported to the Demon Continent in the aftermath of the Teleport Incident. He later brings them to a Migurd Village where he tells Rudeus of his past with the latter volunteering to help restore the honor of the Superd. Ruijerd, Rudeus and Eris eventually forms the party Dead End and joins the Adventure Guild to use the money they earn to travel back to the Central Continent where Ruijerd is given the alias "Watch Dog".

karakterler.baslangic: Similar to other Dragon Race people such as Perugius, Orsted has silver hair and golden eyes with an overpowering look.
karakterler.ozet: Orsted was born roughly 10,000~20,000 years ago in the Dragon World from the union between his father, the First Dragon God, and his mother Lunaria, the daughter of the Human God. However, at the time of his birth, his father had still not decided on a name for him yet despite his wife urgings to give him one. The world was split into six in this era, each home to a different race and ruled by a god: the human world, dragon world, demon world, beast world, ocean world, and sky world. However, at some point, Orsted's mother ended up being killed under mysterious circumstances. The "Human God", claimed that the other gods had conspired against the Dragon God, resulting in his wife's death.

karakterler.baslangic: He has a blank white face coupled with a grin that eludes memory, which gives off the feeling that his face is covered in a mosaic.
karakterler.ozet: Hitogami's exact origins is unknown. It is known that after the Creator God's death, unbeknownst to anyone, he was born within the Void World. At some point in the distant past, the being who would come to be known as Hitogami killed or otherwise usurped the original Human God and took his form. He then began manipulating the First Dragon God and his five Dragon Generals into destroying the other four worlds and then proceeded to help the survivors of those ruined worlds to flee into the Human World. When the five Dragon Generals turned on the Dragon God and weakened him, Hitogami took that opportunity to strike a fatal blow to the Dragon God and then destroy the Dragon World.

karakterler.baslangic: Being born with Dragon Tribe and Demon blood, Demon Dragon King Laplace before he was split in two was described as over 2 meter tall with silver hair with patches of green but has lesser scales compared to those of the Dragon Tribe.
He is a tall, thin, oval-faced man, with his cheekbones clearly visible.
karakterler.ozet: Zanoba is born as the Third Prince of Shirone Kingdom. When he was three years old, he accidentally killed his brother Julius, the Fourth Prince causing him to be known as the Head Ripping Prince. When he was 15 years old, he also killed his wife by accident.

karakterler.baslangic: Ghislane has dark skin and wears a revealing leather outfit.
karakterler.ozet: She was first seen coming to pick up Rudeus and safely transported him to the Citadel of Roa. When Rudeus' plan backfired, Eris and Rudeus were kidnapped again and almost died, but Ghislaine stepped in just in time and saved both of them by finishing off the kidnappers. After Rudeus was hired as Eris' tutor, she was also tutored by him, she convinced Eris that math and literacy was important after telling her tale of how she nearly died from being scammed before. Later, on Eris' tenth birthday, Rudeus saw that she was hungry, but being a guard on duty, she was unable to go and dine with the other guests. In a kind act, Rudeus asked a maid to set up a private party with food in his room.

karakterler.baslangic:
thumb|160px|left|Elinalise in Volume 5
Like many of her race, Elinalise is shown to be a beautiful and youthful-looking elf of 200+ years.
karakterler.ozet:
300px|right|thumb|Elinalise with Roxy and Tallhand heading to the Demon Continent
After the Teleport Incident, Elinalise accepted Paul's request of finding his family without him knowing. Together with Roxy and Talhand, they began a journey throughout the Demon Continent in search of Paul's family. After Roxy learns the location of Zenith, they part ways where Roxy and Tallhand heads to Millishion to inform Paul while Elinalise finds Rudeus and informs him as well. She also urges him to live his own life and joins him on his travels to the Magic Academy. She sees the Academy as a great place to meet men.

karakterler.baslangic: Geese is a Demon Race with described to have monkey-like facial features.
karakterler.ozet: Geese is the last survivor of the Demon Race Nuka Tribe, which was wiped out due to Hitogami's schemes. He is also a member of the party, Fangs of the Black Wolf, the same party that Paul, Zenith, Tallhand, Elinalise, and Ghislaine were all a part of. He served as the thief and jack of all trades in the party, avoiding traps in the dungeon and cooking are but some of his contributions to the party. He lives his life by his code which he calls Jinx as it was the reason how he survived so many dangerous situations since he was a child. After teaching Zenith how to cook, he swore to never teach anyone how to cook anymore since that was what eventually lead to the dissolution of their party.

karakterler.baslangic: left|frameless|Headless statue of Kishirika before her death.
karakterler.ozet:
===Volume 2 - Infancy Period===
Before the Teleport Incident, Kishirika was among those who noticed the unusual phenomenon forming above the Citadel of Roa. She attempted to investigate it using her various Demon Eyes but was unable to identify the individual responsible for the phenomenon. ===Volume 4 - Juvenile Period - Voyage===
Following guidance from Hitogami, Rudeus encountered Kishirika in an alley at Wind Port. Misinterpreting the situation when he saw her with a suspicious man, Rudeus attacked and knocked the man unconscious. Kishirika was starving, and Rudeus provided her with food.

karakterler.baslangic: Auber is an eccentric man with red eyes wearing a rainbow-colored coat, knee-length shorts, and four swords at his hip.
karakterler.ozet: thumb|Auber using his flame attack against Eris, and Rudeus using his Water Wall spell to protect her. Took part in three separate assassination attempts on Ariel Anemoi Asura, all of which were stopped by Rudeus Greyrat. In the first, after patiently waiting for his chance to kill Rudeus the second he cast his magic, he rushed in to attack but was surprised to see that Rudeus turned around just in time to see him face to face. After a few words, Auber rushed towards Rudeus and with his immense speed along with Rudeus' surprise at suddenly facing Auber, Rudeus' only option to defend was to launch the Zaliff Gauntlet towards Auber.

karakterler.baslangic: Isolde is a beautiful woman with a round face and long, black (ultramarine) silky hair who appears to be in her twenties.
karakterler.ozet: Isolde is the granddaughter of the famous Water God Reida Lia. Her father had no surname due to Reida abandoning hers, and instead Isolde took up her mother's surname. Her parents had died at an early age, leaving her older brother, Tantris, to take care of her. Possessing raw natural talent for swordsmanship, she eventually surpasses her older brother under the age of ten to become the next prized pupil of Reida Lia. This leads her on a journey towards becoming even stronger, eventually crossing paths with Eris Greyrat and Nina Farion, her two rivals and also closest friends.

karakterler.baslangic: Perugius has an appearance similar to Orsted, but does not have a curse of being hated.
karakterler.ozet: Dora spawns the egg of Perugius prematurely about the same time Laplace was battling the culprit responsible for Crystal's death. Days later, Laplace informs Dora of the capture of the culprit to the relief of Dora. Dora then presents Perugius' egg to Laplace and asks him to name her child but Laplace was reluctant since he does not know if its a boy or girl but Dora assures him that her child is a boy, so Laplace names him Perugius and becomes his godfather.

karakterler.baslangic: Gal Farion is described as an adult man with blue hair with a face "like a ferocious wolf" and a prominent scar below his left eye that reaches below his left ear and another scar at the tip of his right eye.
karakterler.ozet:
Gal-Farion-vs-Enzo-MT-MN-ESS-Ch05-2.png|A young Gal Farion battling Enzo Moreira in the Manga
Orsted-vs-Gal-Farion-MT-MN-ESS-Ch06-2.png|Gal Farion defeated by Orsted in the Manga
MT-AN-S1-E15-PNG-16.png|Gal Farion meeting Ghislaine in the Anime

At a young age, is already a talented Swordsman and when during his time at the Holy Land of Swords where he defeats Enzo Moreira who was a Sword Saint in a sparring match. Gal Farion describes himself as stubborn Sword Saint when he challenged Orsted to a battle. Naturally, he lost but survived with his 4 limbs intact and his stubborness was completely broken.

karakterler.baslangic: Nina is a beautiful girl, with flowing dark blue hair gathered behind her.
karakterler.ozet: Nina was introduced as an opponent for Eris in Volume 8. Nina was angry that Eris preemptively attacked Jino before their duel even began and vowed to kill Eris during her duel. When the duel began, Nina was able to break Eris's sword and expected the victory, but instead was beaten unconscious by Eris's fists and kicks. Being shamed in front of her peers, she began to hate Eris and began a rivalry with her. Nina tried to get find time for her rivalry and to be in contact with Eris since seemed to be constantly busy with training with Ghislaine Dedoldia and Gal Farion.

karakterler.baslangic: He is short and has dark brown hair.
karakterler.ozet: When Cliff was 5, Harry Grimoire, a person who held a high position in the Millis religious organization adopted him. Cliff is a gifted child that became Advanced Rank in Summoning, Detoxification, Healing, and Fire at a young age. He is also the biological grandson of the current Pope of Millis. He had a dream of becoming an adventurer which leads to him meeting with Eris.

karakterler.baslangic: Ariel has long blonde hair with blue eyes and a very attractive face.
karakterler.ozet:
thumb|left|150px|Ariel being protected by Lilia from assassins
Ariel is as the second princess of the Asura Kingdom where she inherited the lovely features and shining golden hair from her mother the queen consort, a famous beauty; from her father, the king of Asura Kingdom, she inherited a peerless beautiful voice. Since her childhood, Ariel already possess an overpowering charisma where the majority of Asura Kingdom's residents already sees her as the most beautiful princess who have ever lived and as the daughter of the queen consort, her supporters consider her the legitimate heir to the throne but also makes her the target for assassination.

karakterler.baslangic: Luke is tall, well-built and extremely good looking.
karakterler.ozet: Luke Notos Greyrat does not appear many times in the first half of the volumes. However, starting with Volume 8, Luke takes a much larger role in the main cast. He serves as the primary knight to Princes Ariel, and a close friend and coworker to Sylphiette. During the earlier portions of Volumes 8 and 9, Luke primarily antagonizes Rudeus, who he believes is a bad influence on Sylphy, and due to his status as the son of Paul Notos Greyrat, who is Luke's uncle. During the latter half of Volume 9, Luke's opinion of Rudeus change.

karakterler.baslangic: Nanahoshi is a Japanese teenage girl with long black hair, described as being above average in appearance.
karakterler.ozet: Nanahoshi was first introduced in volume 6 of the LN/WN accompanying Orsted when they encountered Dead End on their journey to the Fittoa Region. After Orsted mortally wounded Rudeus Greyrat, she told Orsted to spare Rudeus' life, so Orsted cast healing magic on him. Nanahoshi meets with Rudeus once again at Ranoa Magic Academy where she establishes herself as a Class A Mage because of the sweeping changes she introduced in the Academy and is also a Special Student. After giving an explanation of her intentions, Nanahoshi, Rudeus and Sylphiette begin researching on the cause of the Teleport Incident.

karakterler.baslangic: Due to her Dwarf Heritage, Julie is a small girl with a very thin frame, pale skin, and unkempt, feathery light red-orange hair.
karakterler.ozet:
300px|left|thumb|Julie during the time she is a slave in the Anime
Julie is the only child of Bazelle, a blacksmith and Lilitella, a jewelcrafter. At some point because of debt, she and her parents were sold into slavery where Julie's parents were already sold while Julie remains in a Slave Market in Sharia due to being undernourished and sick where she first meets Rudeus, Zanoba and Fitts.

karakterler.baslangic: Jinas has short gray hair that frames his face.
karakterler.ozet: After he heard the achievements of Rudeus, Jinas sent a letter to him, inviting him to study as a special student in Ranoa. After receiving a letter that Zenith has been found, Rudeus meets with Jinas to arrange a leave of absence for him and Elinalise from Ranoa Magic Academy as they need to travel to Rapan, Begaritt Continent. Rudeus and Roxy returns to the university to report their return where Roxy went to talk with Jinas to ask for a job as a teacher. They had a talk about their past dispute, after that Jinas hired Roxy as a teacher of the university. At some point, he replaces Georg as the Head Teacher of the Academy.

karakterler.baslangic: Linia has short, grey hair with a pair of cat ears and a tail of the same color.
karakterler.ozet: After graduating she become a peddler selling goods from Asura to the North and vice-versa. However she gained her funds through loaning, eventually she found herself unable to pay her loans and thus she was taken into custody and turned into a slave. One day she escaped and ran away, she was then found by Eris and decided to help her. She was then picked up by Eris to become her pet. She then later helps set up and joins the Rude Mercenary Company to help pay off her debt to Rudeus Greyrat after he bought her to stop her from getting sold off to an Asuran Noble.

karakterler.baslangic: Pursena has long gray hair and red eyes, with a pair of drooping dog ears on top of her head and a fluffy tail behind indicating her Adoldia heritage.
karakterler.ozet: After graduating and returned to her village, she became a warrior chief and quickly gained the trust of the other warriors with her healing magic. 10 days before Rudeus arrived with Linia and the Sacred Beast, she relieved a guard of their duty to guard the dried meat storage and her hunger got the best of her and she committed a felony by eating all of the food in the storage. She was then imprisoned until Rudeus arrived and got a confession out of her. Since then she was designated as one of the Sacred Beast caretakers. Note: This section is under construction and revision.

karakterler.baslangic: Badigadi is described to be incredibly tall, with 6 muscular arms (where it is usually seen that the top pair is folded on his chest, the middle pair stretched out as if he is flexing, and the bottom pair is holding onto his hips) violet hair and a jet black (black-purple in the anime) skin that changes color to brown when he's drunk.
karakterler.ozet: Badigadi took interest on Rudeus when his fiance Kishirika mentions how amazing that child is because of his unusually high mana capacity and Badigadi wants to see him while openly admitting that he is jealous of Kishirika's attitude towards Rudeus. After deciding on splitting the group, Badigadi accompanies Elinalise Dragonroad to inform Rudeus on the location of his mother Zenith Greyrat who has been missing since the Teleport Incident. Unfortunately, he later becomes one of the final antagonists of the series, after it is revealed that he is one of Hitogami's apostles.

karakterler.baslangic: According to Rudeus, Atofe resembles the stereotypical image of a demon more closely than almost anyone he has encountered.
karakterler.ozet: Atofe is one of the most powerful Demon Lords and possesses combat ability comparable to the lower ranks of the Seven Great Powers. She's on par with a North God in overall strength, and the difference between her and the lower ranks of the Seven Great Powers is so small that there's no telling who would win if she fought one of them. Over several thousand years, she was said to have never lost a formal duel to anyone other than Demon God Laplace and Kalman I. Her immense physical ability, immortality, and swordsmanship make her extremely difficult to defeat through conventional combat.

karakterler.baslangic: Moore is an immortal demon who looks like an imposing middle-aged man, with white hair, moustache and beard and reddish-brown eyes.
karakterler.ozet: Moore is the captain of Atoferatofe Rybak's Royal Guards and also her aide in Rikarisu City

karakterler.baslangic: She has brown skin with braided hair tied to a bunch in a ponytail.

Suzanne tried to talk to the depressed Rudeus when they were on the carriage traveling to Rosenburg, and when Rudeus was taking on a A-ranked quest to kill Luster Grizzlies solo, she offered to invite him as a temporary member to do the quest together. karakterler.baslangic: Sara is a pretty young girl with light blue eyes and short blond hair during her debut.
karakterler.ozet:

300px|right|thumb|Sara and Counter Arrow Party
Sara and her party first met a depressed Rudeus in a carriage that was traveling to Ranoa Kingdom. She became angry at Rudeus when Suzanne was being nice to him but Rudeus does not want to talk about himself. Later on, Rudeus joined her party after Suzanne recruited him for a Rank A quest of killing Grizzlies for their hide that Rudeus plans to do alone.

karakterler.ozet: Timothy and his party are travelling to the northern region of Central Continent where they first meet Rudeus Greyrat who is apparently depressed. Their party eventually assists him to complete a Rank A mission after being convinced by Suzanne. 'Note: This section is under construction and revision.

In a mission in Trier Forest, a blizzard greatly lowers the visibility of the party and and they were ambushed by a group of Snow Buffaloes that killed him and forced the party to leave Sara behind.

karakterler.ozet:
250px|left|thumb|Soldat Heckler during his childhood in the Manga

Soldat Heckler is born from a family of nobility but during his childhood they were attacked by unknown assailants and while the servants tells Soldat and his mother to flee, Soldat was the sole survivor when her mother throw her over the bridge and he gets washed away to a dump while waiting for her mother to return. Soldat eventually becomes the leader of the Stepped Leader that is also part of the "Thunderbolt" Clan

karakterler.baslangic: Sieghart has the same emerald-green hair color as Sylphiette before the Teleport Incident and also has a face similar to Rudeus.
karakterler.ozet: Sieghart is the second child of Rudeus Greyrat and Sylpiette. Before Sieg was born, Perugius Dola tells Rudeus and Sylphy that should they have a son, bring him to Perugius to give him a name. In order establish closer ties with the Greyrat Family, Queen Ariel Anemoi Asura and Rudeus agrees to have an arranged marriage with their children, making Ars Greyrat to be the first candidate until Ars marries Aisha Greyrat, which makes Sieg, the second son be the next candidate to be married to Sariel Anemoi Asura even though they have never met until they enter the Asura Royal Academy. Note: This section is under construction and revision.

karakterler.baslangic: He has red hair like his mother and has emerald eyes like his father.
karakterler.ozet: When Ars was a baby, he was very attached to women, especially Aisha, and had a strong dislike for men, crying while Rudeus was holding him. In a deleted chapter, Ars grew feelings for Aisha. He was caught being seduced by Aisha by Rudeus and Sylphiette. After hearing Ars admitting that he wanted to be with Aisha, Eris became furious and gave him a beating. After Lilia got angry at them, Aisha proposed the idea of running away to Millishion to Ars.

karakterler.baslangic: Lara has light blue hair and eyes like her mother Roxy that covers most of her forehead except the middle with a single ahoge and her mouth is just like Rudeus.
karakterler.ozet: Before Rudeus and Roxy were married, Hitogami tried to get rid of Roxy many times, first by telling Rudeus to get a Demon Eye from Kishirika Kishirisu, leading him to avoid meeting Roxy in Wind Port. He then attempted to stop him from going to the Teleport Labyrinth to save Zenith (and Roxy) which failed because of Rudeus and Roxy having a strong fate. Hitogami further manipulated Rudeus by leading him into a situation that would end up with Roxy falling ill and die later due to Magic Stone Disease while Roxy is pregnant with Lara, but this was prevented by the intervention of his future self.

karakterler.baslangic: She has the same hair color as Rudeus.
karakterler.ozet: Lucy is the first born child between Rudeus and Sylphy who are childhood friends from Buena Village. But the two got separated and due to the Teleport Incident, their circumstances greatly changed as they eventually both ended up in Ranoa Magic Academy, Sharia where they reunited and got married. Before Rudeus journeys to the Teleportation Labyrinth in the Begaritt Continent he decides that he would name their child to be Sirius if its a boy and Lucy if it is a girl but this was met with uneasiness with everyone in the family as it was considered taboo so Rudeus decides to give the name when he returns.

karakterler.ozet: Lily inherited the Magic Armor research, and the production of an All-Purpose Magic Armor was completed in K483. It was useful for reducing the amount of casualties during the subjugation of large monsters.

karakterler.baslangic: Christina Greyrat is identical to her mother.
karakterler.ozet: Christina is the second child of Rudeus and Eris Greyrat who they affectionately refer to as Chris.

karakterler.baslangic: His age seems to be around 50 years old, and his dark brown hair is mixed with a little white hair.
karakterler.ozet: In the manga he was the first one to talk to Rudeus criticizing him for improper noble etiquette. He too also fell for the charm of young Rudy, stating that he would wage war to make him head of the Notos house hold. After the Teleport Incident, he was blamed for the loss of the Fittoa Region and was executed. It was later revealed that the Boreas Greyrat family bought a lot of beastmen slaves as they were infatuated with them.

karakterler.baslangic: Hilda Boreas Greyrat is a tall, elegant woman with a regal and imposing presence.
karakterler.ozet:
Hilda is introduced to Rudeus where she scoffs at his greeting and they barely interact with each and when they do, she would angrily stare at him making Rudeus wonder if he has done something to offend her. 200px|left|thumb|Hilda hugging Rudeus in the Anime
During the party for Rudeus' 10th birthday, Hilda's attitude towards Rudeus has greatly changed and seeing the budding relationship between Rudeus and Eris, she proposes that Rudeus marry Eris, much to Eris' surprise. At the middle of the party, Hilda drank quite a lot and become drunk but her face is full of smiles and laughing boisterously. Before retired for the night, she gave Rudeus and a goodnight kiss and walked back to her room.

karakterler.baslangic: Slender body and bright tea-colored hair.
karakterler.ozet: At the request of Paul, Philip hires Rudeus that he reluctantly accepted him to be her daughter's tutor where he shows interest on Rudeus' plan and arrange that they both be kidnapped. After Rudeus' birthday party, Philip discusses his plans from behind the scenes to make Rudeus the head of the Boreas Family to that was previously impossible with Eris but Rudeus dismisses it as merely drinking chatter. In the aftermath of the Teleport Incident, Philip and Hilda are teleported to the Conflict Zone at the southern part of the Central Continent where they are captured and tortured to death.

karakterler.baslangic: Soldat has blond hair, blue eyes and sharp features like many of the Northern people.
karakterler.ozet:
250px|left|thumb|Soldat Heckler during his childhood in the Manga

Soldat Heckler is born from a family of nobility but during his childhood they were attacked by unknown assailants and while the servants tells Soldat and his mother to flee, Soldat was the sole survivor when her mother throw her over the bridge and he gets washed away to a dump while waiting for her mother to return. Soldat eventually becomes the leader of the Stepped Leader that is also part of the "Thunderbolt" Clan

karakterler.baslangic: Almanfi has medium-length blond hair tied back in a ponytail near his right ear.
karakterler.ozet: Almanfi of the Bright is a Spirit Familiar created by Perugius with Summoning Magic developed during the Six-Faced World era by Armored Dragon King Dora, Perugius' mother . Almanfi loyally serves Perugius to this day.

karakterler.baslangic: Sylvaril has near-white, golden hair draping down her shoulders.
karakterler.ozet: She was the first familiar of Perugius, and the only one who isn't a summoned spirit. Apparently this stems from 400 years ago when Perugius was on a Laplace Campaign, he saved Sylvaril and from then, she has served him since.

karakterler.baslangic: Vita is a pile of blue slime.
karakterler.ozet: He was one of the Hitogami's apostles in last battle in Biheiril Kingdom. When he tried to use his illusion techniques against Rudeus, he was killed by The Bone Ring of Laxus, a ring made by the Death God Laxus to counter him. karakterler.baslangic: Has a skull-like face, in the sense that his face is so sickly that his skin wraps tightly around his face.
karakterler.ozet: After retiring he returned to his home country and started working as a chef and restaurant owner but soon the restaurant became bankrupt, leaving him with a huge debt. He then started working in Dragon King Kingdom as a Knight to pay off the debt.

karakterler.baslangic: Clive is a pretty boy with looks so similar to his father Cliff in terms of his hair and lips while his eyes and features were quite like Elinalise and there was no doubt that he'd be popular with both Human and Elf girls in the future.

Lunaria became the wife of the First Dragon God at the suggestion of the Human God. By the time Lunaria became pregnant, the First Dragon God realizes that she seemed more special than the Dragon Tribe and grew to love her that he always spends time with her when he is home. When the First Dragon God brings Laplace to their home, Lunaria welcomes him and stays by his side, watching over him serenely but lets the servants take care of his other needs despite her own child is about to be born which makes Laplace view her like his mother as well.

karakterler.baslangic: She is pointed to be beautiful with long red hair, red eyes and nice figure.
karakterler.ozet: Her full name is Eris Boreas Greyrat. The Boreas was one of the great noble families in the Asura Kingdom who rules the Fittoa Region. Her behavior prior to meeting Rudeus was uncontrollable and violent. She was considered a failure as a noble. After the Teleport Incident, she was accompanied by Rudeus and Ruijerd on her way to the Central Continent.

karakterler.baslangic: Roxy is shown as a short statured adult woman in her physical teenage appearance between 15 or 16 years old.
karakterler.ozet: Roxy is born to Rowin Migurdia and Rokari Migurdia of the Migurd Tribe, part of the Race in the Demon Continent. However, she was born without her race's special ability to communicate telepathically, so her parents taught her how to talk normally. Throughout her childhood, she would often always feel annoyed and isolated with her race's silent conversation and ran away from her village after being impressed by a Magician who visited her village one day. Roxy becomes an Adventurer to get some money in order to leave the Demon Continent where she joins the party Rikarisu Gang with Dale, Nokopara and Blaze but the party eventually disbanded after the death of Dale.

karakterler.baslangic: Sylphy has pale skin, elfish ears, and red eyes.

karakterler.ozet: In K427, the Rude Mercenary Company was founded by Aisha and Linia in order to find a way for her to pay off Linia's debt to Rudeus when he bought her from slave dealers. Since she was useless at house work, causing discord within the Greyrat Family, they needed to find another way for her to pay off her debt. Monopolizing on her charisma to attract people and using the start up money given to her by Rudeus, with Aisha managing her, the two were able to create a company. The Rude Mercenary Company provides mercenary jobs such as hiring bodyguards, it is also a recruiting ground for able people to run Zanoba's doll stores, and the ORSTED Corporation.
